policy.method: fixed calibration-free NF4 W4A6 fake PTQ
policy.scale_storage: FP16 for both weight and activation blocks
policy.activation_rule: dynamic symmetric INT6, one FP16 absmax scale per 64 contiguous values
policy.activation_zero_block_rule: scale=0, integer code=0, exact zero reconstruction
policy.rounding: NF4 nearest fixed codepoint; INT6 torch round-to-nearest-even
policy.targets: all nn.Linear under model.layers; fixed architecture scope
policy.excluded: input embedding and tied lm_head stay FP16

effective_bit_rate.scope: 252 decoder Linear weights and their input activations; embedding, lm_head, norms excluded

activation_format: dynamic symmetric INT6 block64 with FP16 scale
